Severity levels:
critical: would change patient management.
major: would need an amended report.
minor: internal inconsistency without clinical consequence.

Error types:
C1 — Value–interpretation mismatch: interpretation text contradicts the numbers. Default severity: major.
C2 — Derived-index inconsistency: MCH/MCHC inconsistent with Hb, RBC and Hct; differential not summing to 100; absolute counts inconsistent with WBC. Default severity: minor or major.
C3 — Missed critical finding: a critical value or finding with no flag, comment or recommendation. Default severity: critical.
